purpose: Governed B04-A database capability for idempotent self-scoped create, revise and retire of one complete absolute earliest-start Temporal Constraint rule with expected-state CAS.

routine.return_type: TABLE(constraint_ref uuid, subject_native_ref uuid, material_state_ref uuid, active boolean, created_at timestamp with time zone, replayed boolean)

state_history.material_state_behavior: Create/revise atomically append complete immutable rule MaterialStates; retire does not erase prior rule state.
state_history.current_binding: Create establishes current binding/history, revise performs expected-state CAS then moves current selection, retire performs CAS then removes only the current binding and closes history.
state_history.chronology: Accepted mutation time establishes current-history episode boundaries; idempotent replay returns the originally accepted result rather than fabricating a new transition.
state_history.immutability_policy: The routine never rewrites an existing rule MaterialState. Same operation id plus changed material intent conflicts.

lifecycle.retention: Mutation receipts and historical canonical states are retained for replay and reconstructible history.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: Retire closes currentness only; no canonical constraint/history delete path is exposed.

obligations: only self-owned Activity or Event subjects are admitted
stale expected state and operation-id intent reuse are rejected
runtime executes only this governed capability rather than direct canonical table DML
